title: Constant sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\et X$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and let $\mathcal A$ be the category of values: sets, abelian groups, or modules over a commutative ring $\Lambda$ (the cases used; any category of values in which sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] exists will do). Write $\shv{\et X}$ for the category of sheaves on $\et X$ with values in $\mathcal A$ ([def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]). For $M\in\mathcal A$ let $M_X$ be the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]: the sheafification of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto M$ (all restriction maps the identity); $M\mapsto M_X$ is a functor $\mathcal A\to\shv{\et X}$ (sheafification composed with the constant-presheaf functor), and it is left adjoint to global sections $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F(X)$, evaluation at the final object $\mathrm{id}:X\to X$ of $\et X$ [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-maps-global-sections]. A sheaf $\mathcal F\in\shv{\et X}$ is *constant* if it lies in the essential image of this functor, i.e. if there are $M\in\mathcal A$ and an isomorphism $\mathcal F\cong M_X$ in $\shv{\et X}$. (Well-definedness: the functor exists because sheafification exists for these $\mathcal A$ on $\et X$; the notion does not depend on the choice of a left adjoint of global sections, any two being isomorphic functors, and it is invariant under isomorphism of sheaves. Not to be confused with *locally constant*, [def-constructible-locally-constant], which asks this only on the members of an etale covering.)
